title: A Loop's reviewers review one after the other: each is handed the feedback of the reviewers before it that did not approve, and the producer's revision every rejection, each named by its reviewer's role or else its channel id
notes: Python: test_loop_strategy.py TestRunReviewers::test_sequential_multiple_reviewers, TestReviewSequential::test_feedback_chains_to_next_reviewer, test_reviewer_uses_role_for_name, test_reviewer_without_role_uses_channel_id, TestFeedbackCombination::test_multiple_reviewer_feedback_combined. The style reviewer has no role: its feedback is named by its channel id.
